title: The largest city on Earth: six thousand years of the world's biggest cities
excerpt: From Uruk to Dhaka: I followed the title of the world's largest city through 85 snapshots from 3700 BC to 2050. 30 cities have held it, Chinese capitals for most of seven centuries, London for about 99 years, and the centre of the urban world has wandered from Mesopotamia to the Atlantic and back to Asia.
seo_description: The world's largest city from 3700 BC to 2050: 30 cities from Uruk to Dhaka, London's century and the path of the urban world's centre.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The largest city on Earth' in black, red and gold on pale paper, beside a world map with dots for every city that has been the world's largest and a line coloured from purple to yellow tracing the centre of the 25 largest cities from Mesopotamia across Central Asia, up over the Arctic and down to Tibet, and below it a line chart of the largest city's population rising from Uruk to Dhaka.
